name: composer-mcp
description: Drives SOLIDWORKS Composer on this PC through its COM API.
long_description: Keeps a Composer window connected through one persistent PowerShell session: open files, read the full COM API, and run PowerShell scripts against Composer ($app.Open(...), $doc.RenderMode = 3, $app.RunRibbonCommand(32), ...). Exports SVG files through the Technical Illustration workshop (all views, one view or a list). Works around Composer's broken IDispatch by calling its dual interfaces through the vtable. Windows only; Composer must be registered for COM (composer.exe /regserver).

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check or start the Composer connection

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Export SVG via the Technical Illustration workshop
